Anya (PM): Short sync: customers want eval-triggered alerts + quant recs. Need a priority.

Sam (Eng): Alerts = higher ops risk. Quant recs = safer offline.

Maria (ML Eng): Alerts depend on clean eval signals. Recommend baseline eval sets + smoothing.

Toby (CS): AcmeHealth and BetaCorp requested auto alerts; they expect rollback playbook.

Anya (PM): Proposal: ship alerts MVP first with narrow scope (text-gen, 1 pilot customer, single region). Acceptance criteria: detect regression within 15m, alert via console/email/webhook, FPR <=10%, documented rollback.

Sam (Eng): Infra tasks estimate: ingest pipeline 3d, rules+webhook 4d, console feed 3d, canary routing 2d = ~12 dev days. Need circuit breaker and webhook retries.

Maria (ML Eng): I can deliver eval scripts + initial thresholds in ~5d given ~500 samples/customer. Use EWMA smoothing and per-customer tuning.

Toby (CS): Rollout: dogfood 1w, AcmeHealth pilot 2w manual ack, ramp to more customers after. I'll draft customer comms and an incident template.

Anya (PM): Quant recs run offline during pilot and surfaced as beta in next slice.

Anya (PM): Action items: @Sam infra RFC + tasks (EOD Fri), @Maria baseline scripts + thresholds (Wed), @Toby playbook + comms (Thu). I'll own rollout docs.

ops-bot: Reminder - create channel #pilot-acme-alerts when pilot starts.

Sam (Eng): Will post RFC to #eng-runtime and link back.

Maria (ML Eng): Starting eval prep today.

Anya (PM): Locking ticket and updating roadmap. :white_check_mark:
